`omp update` is complete. The version is now 15.5.10 (up from 15.5.6):

- **npm/bun route**: `@oh-my-pi/pi-coding-agent@15.5.10` installed globally — `omp` resolves to the TypeScript source entrypoint via bun.
- **Standalone binary** at `/root/.local/bin/omp`: still 15.5.6. The GitHub release download (171 MB) is bottlenecked by this environment's network bandwidth to `release-assets.githubusercontent.com` — the transfer keeps timing out. The symlink at `/root/.npm-global/bin/omp` takes PATH priority, so `omp` runs 15.5.10 regardless.

The npm/bun-based `omp` is fully functional. If you need the standalone binary, the download needs a network with better connectivity to GitHub release assets.
